title: Ribose-seq: ribonucleotides in DNA to Illumina library
protocol: Extract a minimum of 10 ug of genomic DNA from the cells.
Quantify the amount of extracted genomic DNA using Qubit 2.0 (dsDNA HS).
Resuspend oligonucleotides Adaptor.L in DNase/RNase-free water to a concentration of 50 uM.
Resuspend oligonucleotides Adaptor.S in DNase/RNase-free water to a concentration of 500 uM.
Mix Annealing Buffer, 3 uL 50 uM Adaptor.L, 25 uL 500 uM Adaptor.S, and 9.5 uL H2O to make a total volume of 50 uL for annealing.
Heat the mixture to 95–100 °C and gradually cool to room temperature for annealing.
Desalt the mixture using a spin column to purify the ds Adaptor.L/Adaptor.S.
Use NanoDrop to quantify the amount of desalted ds Adaptor.L/Adaptor.S.
Set up 2 identical reactions of restriction enzyme digestion of genomic DNA.
Add 12 uL of 10X NEBuffer 2.
Add 5 ug of genomic DNA (x uL).
Add 4 uL of 20U/uL DraI.
Add 4 uL of 20U/uL EcoRV.
Add 4 uL of 5U/uL SspI.
Add H₂O to a total volume of 120 uL.
Incubate at 37 °C overnight.
Purify the fragmented DNA by using a spin column.
Use Qubit 2.0 (dsDNA HS) to quantify the amount of fragmented DNA.
Check the size range of the fragmented DNA using the Experion DNA 12K Analysis Kit.
Set up a dA-tailing reaction by mixing 5 μL of 10X NEBuffer 2, 1 μL of 10 mM dATP, 25 μL of 200 ng/μL fragmented DNA (5 μg), and 3 μL of 5U/μL Klenow Fragment.
Incubate the dA-tailing reaction mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Purify the dA-tailed DNA using a spin column with an elution volume of 30 μL.
Set up a sequencing adaptor-ligation reaction by mixing 5 μL of 10X T4 DNA Ligase Buffer, 5 μL of 10 uM Adaptor.L/Adaptor.S, 30 μL of dA-tailed DNA, and 5 μL of 400U/μL T4 DNA Ligase.
Incubate the adaptor-ligation reaction mixture at 15 °C overnight.
Purify the ligated DNA using Agencourt RNAClean XP with an elution volume of 30 μL.
Set up an alkali-treatment reaction by mixing 7.5 μL of 2 M NaOH, 30 μL of adaptor-ligated DNA, and 12.5 μL of H₂O.
Incubate the alkali treatment mixture at 55 °C for 2 hours.
Neutralize the alkali-treated DNA with 2 M HCl to pH 7 using pH Litmus Paper (typically 7.5–8 μL is needed).
Purify the neutralized DNA using Agencourt RNAClean XP with an elution volume of 20 μL.
Heat the solution at 95 °C for 3 min to denature dsDNA.
Chill the solution on ice immediately after heating.
Set up a reaction without AtRNL by mixing 2 μL of 10X AtRNL Reaction Buffer with 10 μL of alkali-treated DNA and 8 μL of H<sub>2</sub>O.
Prepare a reaction with AtRNL by adding 5.4 μL of 3.75 uM AtRNL to the mixture prepared in the previous step, along with H<sub>2</sub>O to make up the total volume to 20 μL.
Incubate all reactions at 30 °C for 1 hour.
Purify each reaction using RNAClean XP and elute with a volume of 30 μL.
Set up a reaction without T5 Exonuclease by mixing 5 μL of 10X NEBuffer 4, 15 μL of AtRNL– DNA, and H<sub>2</sub>O to make the total volume 50 μL.
Prepare a reaction with T5 Exonuclease by adding 5 μL of 10U/uL T5 Exonuclease to the mixture prepared in the previous step, along with H<sub>2</sub>O to make up the total volume to 50 μL.
Set up another reaction without T5 Exonuclease using 5 μL of 10X NEBuffer 4, 15 μL of AtRNL+ DNA, and H<sub>2</sub>O to make the total volume 50 μL.
Prepare a final reaction with T5 Exonuclease by adding 5 μL of 10U/uL T5 Exonuclease to the mixture prepared in the previous step, along with H<sub>2</sub>O to make up the total volume to 50 μL.
Incubate all reactions at 37 °C for 2 h.
Purify each reaction using RNAClean XP with elution volume of 20 μL.
Set up 4 reactions with Tpt1 for each of AtRNL– T5Exo–, AtRNL– T5Exo+, AtRNL+ T5Exo–, and AtRNL+ T5Exo+ products.
Mix 4 uL of 10X Tpt1 Reaction Buffer with DNA, NAD+, Tpt1 enzyme, and H2O to achieve a final reaction volume of 40 μL.
Incubate all reactions at 30 °C for 1 h.
Purify each reaction using RNAClean XP with elution volume of 30 μL.
Set up 5 PCR reactions: one without any template and four with AtRNL– T5Exo– Tpt1+, AtRNL– T5Exo+ Tpt1+, AtRNL+ T5Exo– Tpt1+, or AtRNL+ T5Exo+ Tpt1+ products.
Mix 10 uL of 5X HF Buffer, 2 uL of 10 mM dNTPs, 0.5 uL of 100% DMSO, 1 uL of 40 uM PCR.1.Index, 1 uL of 40 uM PCR.2, DNA (or no template), and H2O to achieve a final reaction volume of 50 μL.
Add 0.5 uL of 2U/uL Phusion DNA Polymerase to each PCR reaction mixture.
Run PCR with the following settings: 98 °C for 30 s, followed by 30 cycles of 98 °C for 10 s, 65 °C for 20 s, and 72 °C for 30 s, ending with a final extension at 72 °C for 5 m and holding at 4 °C.
Run 6% Non-denaturing PAGE with 10 μL aliquot of each sample.
Stain the gel in 1X SYBR Gold for 30–40 min.
Visualize under UV light.
Purify PCR mixtures from Primers-only, AtRNL– T5Exo+ Tpt1+, and AtRNL+ T5Exo+ Tpt1+ using RNAClean XP with elution volume of 15 uL.
Purify Controls Primers-only and AtRNL– T5Exo+ Tpt1+ to determine the amount of actual ribose-seq library.
Quantify the amount of ribose-seq library using Qubit 2.0 (dsDNA HS).
Confirm that the amount of purified Primers-only product is similar to the amount of AtRNL– T5Exo+ Tpt1+.
Calculate the amount of the actual ribose-seq library by subtracting the amount of AtRNL– T5Exo+ Tpt1+ from AtRNL+ T5Exo+ Tpt1+.
